parsed.diagnosis: Policy-induced wheel-saturation cases with leak plus friction accumulate momentum on 3-wheel control after FDIR isolation. Current policy has no momentum guard, so it stays in NOMINAL until 98% saturation, while sun-point SAFE with payload off would limit buildup. With policy disabled the 4-wheel allocation shares momentum and avoids saturation.
parsed.rationale: Add narrowest momentum guard: if an in-use wheel stays >=97% max for 120s continuous, enter sun-point SAFE and block resume while high. This sheds payload power and holds sun-pointing to stop momentum growth before the 98% for 60s violation. 97% is least sensitive fraction and 120s is longest persistence, so it acts only on prolonged near-saturation that precedes violation.
parsed.why_no_regressions: Strictly narrower than tested 0.97 for 60s which had only 1 regression in 3508 runs. Requires 120s continuous vs 60s, so any run clean under 60s version stays clean, and intermittent high-speed in regressed heater+leak+derate case is less likely to trigger.
